title: OWCP - Employment Verification Services
agency: LABOR, DEPARTMENT OF > OFFICE OF THE ASSISTANT SECRETARY FOR ADMINISTRATION AND MANAGEMENT > DOL - CAS DIVISION 3 PROCUREMENT
description:
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in RFO Subpart 12.2, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Offers are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 

 The Department of Labor, Office of the Senior Procurement Executive, on behalf of The Office of Worker's Compensation Program (OWCP) intends to award a Firm-Fixed-Price contract for the services described.  

   Please use attachment J.2 (Question and Answers excel spreadsheet) to submit Questions Pertaining to this requirement no later than Monday, Nov 23rd, 2026 at noon (ET).   

 Solicitation, Pricing worksheet, Question and Answer worksheet, and QASP are attached.
